legacyImagesNote: Only the H-1 run of show with the Paper settings layer open (v0.3.52) is captured. All other images retain their original capture versions, including the v0.3.51 reduced-scale run of show, the v0.3.50 performance-area image, the v0.3.49 viewpoint image and the v0.3.47 run-of-show image. The older run-of-show picture (release037) is no longer used in the Q-sheet section.

visualReview.method: Direct visual inspection of the full-size Japanese and English H-1 captures: the run of show with the Paper settings layer open shows language, input view and paper size, paper colour, text size, view scale and the single Reset to default; the layer sits beside the left rail and does not cut off any of its fields. Print/Output and selection layers were operated separately in Chromium and WebKit by script (tests/run-of-show-band-layers-browser.cjs).
visualReview.limits: Chromium captures of the bundled feature-test show at 1440x900; Safari, iPad and the Mac app not tested
